name: The Woods
source:
Somewhere unfamiliar, Dani noticed the rabbit ears on her head. Another dream. And yet… lucid enough to notice. Might as well make the most of it, but avoid the cakes. Slowly, she wandered, the forest endless around her.

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/642516]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
在陌生的地方，丹妮注意到她头上的兔子耳朵。另一个梦想。然而……足够清醒地注意到。不妨充分利用它，但不要吃蛋糕。她慢慢地漫步，周围是一望无际的森林。

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/642516]Newgrounds[/url]]
